div.head: Hn 59.16
div.ab: Omne autem bellum per emendacionem et respectum capi debet; addi uero poterit, non etiam demi aliquid eorum in quibus bellum consistet.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 579 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: unter Besserungsmöglichkeit der zu beschwörenden Klage. Über die Erholung beim Eide s. 64, 1d und Brunner Forsch. Gesch. Dt. R. 387
with the possibility of amending the charge that is to be sworn. On correction in the oath see 64, 1d and Brunner Forsch. Gesch. Dt. R. 387
